officialSendingAgency.name: Department of Employment, Ministry of Labour

evidenceNotes: Thailand Department of Employment announced Point System Round 18 in 2026 for 3,300 workers: Manufacturing 2,000, Agriculture/Livestock 1,000 and Construction 300.
Official online registration ran 2026-07-02 through 2026-07-06 and the fee was 960 THB through the designated Krungthai Bank channel.
Manufacturing accepts male and female applicants; the verified Round 18 age window is 18–39, DOB 1986-07-03 through 2008-07-02.
DOE announced 2026-08-10 for the Korean-test eligible list and 2026-10-19 for the skills-test eligible list.
Thailand also ran a separate Special EPS-TOPIK in 2026 for qualified returning workers; those facts are kept outside the Regular Round 18 rules.

On 2026-10-06 HRD Korea published six Thailand General CBT skills-candidate rows. Official examNot matching identifies 57=Round 18 Manufacturing Bangkok and 64=Round 18 Manufacturing Udon Thani; 56/58/63/65 are other sectors and stay excluded. DOE's separate 2026-10-19 local milestone remains in force for local list/instructions.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.authority: Thailand Department of Employment / HRD Korea
stages.action: For Point System Round 18, verify age 18–39 (DOB 1986-07-03 through 2008-07-02), health/communicable-disease fitness, no color blindness, legal/criminal/travel conditions, no Korea deportation/refusal/illegal-law history, no drug history, and total prior E-9/E-10 stay under 5 years.

stages.title: Official online registration
stages.action: Round 18 registration was accepted online through the official TOEA channel from 2026-07-02 through 2026-07-06. The window is closed.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK / Point System fee
stages.action: Official Round 18 application fee: 960 THB, payable through the designated Krungthai Bank payment channel within the official window.

stages.title: Identity / anti-fraud verification
stages.authority: Thailand Department of Employment / HRD Korea
stages.action: Follow the identity-verification requirements in the assigned Round 18 test notice. KEP does not infer extra biometric rules beyond the current official instructions.

stages.title: Registration data verification
stages.action: Submit the electronic application only once and ensure identity/contact data are correct before final submission. Exact upload/document specifications are not asserted until a current official detailed notice is reviewed.

stages.title: Exam eligibility / test notice
stages.action: DOE planned to publish the Korean-test eligible list on 2026-08-10. Use the official DOE/EPS Thailand notice for the assigned venue and test session.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — Round 1
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Thailand Department of Employment
stages.action: Round 18 is a Point System selection. Use only the current official exam notice for the exact Manufacturing test schedule and result; do not reuse Special EPS-TOPIK dates.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Thailand Department of Employment
stages.action: HRD Korea's 2026-10-06 candidate index can now be linked by official examNot: 57=Round 18 Manufacturing Bangkok and 64=Round 18 Manufacturing Udon Thani. Rows 56/58/63/65 are Agriculture/Livestock or Construction and are excluded. Continue to check DOE's separately announced 2026-10-19 local list/instructions.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Thailand Department of Employment
stages.action: Passing the Korean and skills stages does not guarantee employer selection. Final candidate status must follow the current official Point System result notice.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Thailand psychology step is asserted from the verified Round 18 recruitment notice. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology requirements.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.authority: Thailand Department of Employment / designated provider
stages.action: Health fitness is an eligibility condition, but KEP has not yet promoted the exact current Round 18 post-selection medical provider/checklist. Follow the current DOE notice when issued.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: Only follow the current DOE/TOEA instruction for the candidate-file stage after Point System selection. Exact Round 18 documents and timing remain under review.

stages.title: EPS candidate roster
stages.authority: Thailand Department of Employment / HRD Korea
stages.action: Approved candidates are proposed for Korean employer selection through the official EPS process. No private intermediary can guarantee roster priority.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS system. Passing the tests or appearing on the roster does not guarantee employer selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Thailand Department of Employment
stages.action: If selected by a Korean employer, follow the current DOE/EPS notice for SLC review/signing and next steps. Do not pay a broker to obtain or alter an SLC.

stages.title: Post-SLC Thailand requirements
stages.action: Follow only current DOE instructions for training, medical follow-up, visa documents, payments and departure preparation. Older or Special EPS instructions are not current Regular Round 18 rules.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.authority: Thailand Department of Employment / Korean mission
stages.action: Use the current DOE/Korean-mission visa notice. Exact Round 18 Manufacturing visa checklist and charges are not yet mapped in KEP.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only the official pre-departure training assigned by DOE. Exact Round 18 cohort timing/fees remain notice-specific.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow the current Thailand departure notice if a final medical or screening step is explicitly required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.authority: Thailand Department of Employment / HRD Korea
stages.action: Travel only after the official EPS contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete and DOE issues the applicable departure instructions.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
